cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing; a contemporary private overnight ferry cabin with a round window — she sits back after reaching for a folded blank timetable; a starship data archive — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — sketches in a sketchbook and pencil; a hangar maintenance bay — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a walled garden with a lotus pond — standing; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a quiet modern seaside guesthouse bedroom with pale blue walls — she laughs softly at the distant cry of a gull while sitting up from a deep cushioned window seat; a retro-futurist home of rounded chrome appliances and soft panels — sitting on the ground; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — chest-deep in the water; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — drinks from a water bottle; a nightclub with a dance floor under moving coloured lights and a velvet-rope queue at its door — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a resort cabana with a shaded daybed by the water — standing
